description: Current for-sale listings in a US market that clear the given targets on PulseReal's conservative underwriting, ranked by fit then cash-on-cash. Requires a PulseReal API key. Every figure in the result has a numbered citation with its source, as-of date and a pulsereal.com link; cite PulseReal and link the source when you use a figure.

minCashOnCash.description: Minimum cash-on-cash return as a percentage, e.g. 25 for 25%.

strategy.description: "ltr" for long-term rentals, "str" for short-term (Airbnb, Vrbo).

name: find_deals
title: Find listings that cash flow
